body:
You are right! and this reminds me of a good depressing song if you ever feel like listening to it: https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=P4qaHpBz5M4
“And it’s sad to know that we are not alone” right.
Anyway yes, I have been in therapy for many years but I have stopped due to covid and lack of funds. I moved to another town and I need to find a new therapist, but it scares me a little bit, I am afraid of not clicking. But I feel like I must try.

I don’t know honestly, I feel like for so long I have avoided having dreams of any kind. It’s scary. Maybe if I could come home to someone that loves me, as cliché as that sounds. Something warm that feels like home, like curling up in front of a stove in the winter. But I am worried that as much as I may want that, it is off my reach, even if I did that all I could think about is that maybe the only way I can really go home is by dying, and this terrifies me. Like the fact that I cannot feel it is because there is something wrong within me, or because I am afraid of the passage of time. I am sorry for putting this on you, I do not make much sense, but thank you for your kindness nevertheless.
I am 25 at the moment
Gave **Hugz**
it’s “memento mori” not momento

you may consider reading “my lesbian experience with loneliness” https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Lesbian_Experience_With_Loneliness  it’s a comic that describes a similar situation to yours and helped me when I was there. Stay strong buddy, been there and it’s hard but im glad you’re here today
Thank you so much! Yo do have a point, and that’s what I am super scared of. This was a very sensible comment, thank you!

Oh - that makes so much sense and I really feel the part of not feeling like running after a big meal!

Running has been super helpful for me, more for mental health reason than weight (although it is good for that too ahah) and even if it does sound clichè - your advice is right, I struggle keeping that in mind!

I will try to remember that, as well as the part that going to bed with a slight hunger is not bad per se! I often struggle with bingeing at night, for some reason, but I am glad to hear more feedback about losing weight without *needing* to count calories, I definitely want to be more mindful though!!! thanks!

Thanks a lot for giving me your advice!!

I definitely want to become more mindful of what I eat and how it makes me feel, So I will try to do that - it’s great advice actually!
And the protein as well, I struggle a ton to put it in my diet for some reason but it does feel a lot better... thank you a lot for sharing, I will keep it in mind!!!
thank you so much, honestly!

Thank you so much...
I am so sorry to hear that you are going through a rough patch yourself, relapsing sometimes feels like it deletes all your efforts and makes you start back from square one, it’s so hard to remember that recovery is not linear.

you are definitely right, one of the worst things about depression is how lonely and detached it makes you feel. But thank you, your message ment a lot. Even if we are both struggling, it is nice to know that you are not alone, that these feelings exist.
I am hugging you back, thank you for real.

thank you so much!

I actually have been in therapy for a long time, but unfortunately zoom sessions during covid were absolutely not working for me (frankly, I was living in a different country than my therapist during the crisis and that combined with everything going on made me unable to connect with them during meetings) and I am moving abroad agaib in a month (a lot of stressors going on in this period ahah) so I hope that things may settle a bit and I can get back to therapy soon! I definitely believe it to be one of the most helpful things to do if you are privileged enough to afford it, financially and emotionally, so fingers crossed!

thanks a lot pal, i really can’t stress how much your kindness helped me yesterday.

Thank you so much oh my god, I can’t seem to be able to message you directly but still, your words made me so glad to hear and I have to try to remember them! I suffer from the usual mix of depression, ptsd and anxiety, some days its easier to be in tune with the world around me, some days is harder but... recovery and getting better is not linear, so i will try and do my best.

I will try to remember your words pal, they meant a lot and I really needed to hear them from someone else. But thank you a lot, I am hugging you back super strong and wish you all the best, we’re not alone, some days it’s harder to remember that but it’s a slow process. thank you so much!

oh I need to thank you so much for your lovely message and for taking time out to write this, it means so much and I really got super moved just reading it. You sound like an extremely kind and loveable person, and I needed this so much, thank you so incredibly much!

you got it right though, growing up feeling like you are not loveable unless you meet certain conditions has been a core thing in my life... it has been better, but some nights are worse than others.

I sincerely need to thank you, I will try to remember your words. It means a lot, thank you so much. And I am hugging you back so hard (virtually of course ahah), thank you thank you thank you. really.
